title: Prefill: MegaMoE FI NVFP4 (2x8K) + shared-expert side stream
shape: NVFP4 1-node DEP4 slice (step_p.sh -q nvfp4, die-split EP16 emulation 56 experts/GPU, L24 view: 23 MoE layers), F16K at L78K, MegaMoE family busy ms per forward (in-step). Deciding check: real DEP16 4 nodes (93 layers).
basis: MEASURED in-step NVFP4. Slice: baseline 74.01 (int b31121c, single 16K launch, pre-die-split emulation) -> 55.7 ms (int c8a403a = sub-calls + S3, die-split emulation, INFRA 18:05) vs fused L24 achievable 49.5 (INFRA 17:50 model row fix; replaces the additive 73.3 and the 44.9 SOL target). REAL DEP16 (4 nodes, 93 layers, int c8a403a, INFRA 18:35): MegaMoE 263.8 ms vs fused achievable 197.9 (x1.33, target 217.7); the slice is ~13% optimistic (in-node dispatch).
gap_analysis: Real EP16 per 8K sub-call (rank 0 / rank 9 of p16-t7c8a403-nv-prof): main persistent kernel 1341 / 1421 us, router 199 / 279 us, top-k reduce 74 us. The same kernel in the 1-node slice: ~960 us, all-local compute floor 926 us (S3) -> the EP16 link adds ~420 us per launch; S3 (-3 ms on the slice) did not move real EP16. Root cause (code + arithmetic, to be confirmed with the r16 EP16 probe): the knob record uses token_back_mode epi_warps: the FC2 epilogue pushes every route row to its source rank as 28 separate 256-byte UBLK (cp.async.bulk) remote stores (one per 128-hidden CTA tile): per 8K launch per GPU 131K routes x 15/16 remote = 0.88 GB BF16 in 3.4M remote bulk ops, issued from the epilogue warps that already bound the compute side (MMA warp waits 46% on acc-empty, r13/r14). Dispatch pulls one 2 KB row per (token, expert) with one row in flight per transfer warp (0.23 GB). Model (perf-model P3-16, dedup=False): link = per-route bytes at the achievable NVLink rate, 2.14 ms per 16K layer, fused layer = max(ops, link) + drain. SOL design (O2 in the model, beyond its P3-16 row): (1) FC2 epilogue stores BF16 rows locally (local tile store, no remote ops on the epilogue path); (2) per (source rank, source token) group the transfer warps sum the group's local rows in fp32 in fixed top-k order, round to BF16 once and push ONE 7 KB row per group with a multi-stage bulk ring (>= 4 rows in flight per warp); the source top-k reduce sums <= 16 rank partials in rank order (deterministic); (3) dispatch dedup: pull each token once per destination rank and write it to its c local pool rows. Bytes per token 16 -> 10.35 rows (-35%), remote ops per route 28 -> ~0.2 (one 7 KB op per group). Projection per 8K launch: link 0.72 GB at ~1.1 TB/s = 0.65 ms < compute 0.93 ms -> compute-bound layer ~2.0-2.1 ms per 16K (~185-195 ms over 92 layers vs fused achievable 197.9, target 217.7). Precision: BF16 combine wire format kept, fp32 accumulation; partial sums are rounded to BF16 once per (token, rank) instead of once per route.
inefficiencies: FC2 combine = 3.4M 256-byte remote UBLK stores per 8K launch issued by the epilogue warps (epi_warps token-back): op-count/latency bound at EP16, on the compute critical path
No rank-level dedup/pre-combine: 16 BF16 rows per token cross NVLink instead of ~10.35 (model P3-16 also prices 16)
Router 199-279 us per 8K launch at real EP16 (36 us in the slice): cross-rank metadata push absorbs arrival skew
Compute side: MMA warp waits 46% on acc-empty (FC1 epilogue), 23% on operands (r13/r14, EP4 probe)
Top-k reduce 74 us per 8K launch outside the persistent kernel
FIXED (int c8a403a): 2x8K sub-calls; S3 one-reciprocal SiTU
rubin_features: TMA bulk copies over NVLink (pull dispatch, bulk-store combine)
programmatic dependent launch (router -> persistent main kernel)
persistent-grid SM cap / green contexts for side-stream overlap (measured: cap not profitable at this shape)
packed f32x2 FMA + MUFU ex2/rcp in the SiTU epilogue
plan: r15 (EP4, 1 node): token_back_mode epi_warps vs reuse_dispatch_warps vs standalone_warps x random/local (does local FC2 + transfer-warp push work and what does it cost on the compute side)
r16 (real EP16, 8n hold, prewarm on 1 node): same variants + all-local floor at 896 experts: measure the link share at the deployed topology

Implement transfer-warp combine ring (multi-stage, whole-row ops) -> then group pre-combine (router emits per (src rank, src token) groups; fp32 sum in top-k order; one row per group; reduce over rank partials) -> dispatch dedup
Validate: rel-L2 vs oracle, bitwise launch independence tests, EP4 + EP16 standalone, step_p -q nvfp4 slice, real DEP16 step
